figuraperf.config.title: Figura Performance
figuraperf.config.reset.tooltip: Puts every setting back the way it shipped.
figuraperf.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for the full settings screen
figuraperf.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod off, leaving Figura exactly as it was.
figuraperf.option.always_full_self.toolt: Your own avatar is always shown, whatever the distance and the limits say.
figuraperf.option.skip_offscreen.tooltip: Figura keeps working on avatars behind you. This stops that. Turn around and they come back within a tick.
figuraperf.option.texture_uploads.toolti: Spreads avatar texture uploads over frames to smooth the hitch when a crowd loads. 0 removes the limit.
figuraperf.option.skip_shadow.tooltip: With a shader pack the world is drawn again for the shadow map. Avatars there are rarely worth the cost.
figuraperf.option.skip_paperdoll: No avatar in the paper doll
figuraperf.option.skip_paperdoll.tooltip: The doll in the corner is a second full render of your own avatar, every frame.
figuraperf.option.adaptive.tooltip: Shows fewer avatars on its own when the frame rate falls below the target, and more once it recovers.
figuraperf.option.target_fps.tooltip: The frame rate adaptive mode tries to hold.
figuraperf.option.adaptive_floor.tooltip: Adaptive mode always leaves at least this many avatars shown.
figuraperf.option.auto_block.tooltip: Switches off any avatar costing more than the limit below. Off by default: turning someone's avatar off unasked is a strong thing to do.
figuraperf.option.auto_block_millis.tool: An avatar costing more than this per frame is switched off. Blocks are forgotten when the game restarts.
figuraperf.option.auto_block_announce.to: Prints a line naming the avatar that was switched off and what it cost.
figuraperf.option.whitelist.tooltip: Names separated by commas, for example: Glam_Ardor, Contik, WatzyCuh. Case does not matter. These avatars are always shown, whatever the distance and the limit say.
figuraperf.option.blocked_list.tooltip: Names separated by commas, for example: Glam_Ardor, Contik, WatzyCuh. Case does not matter. Their avatars are never shown to you.
figuraperf.option.overlay.tooltip: Shows the frame rate, how many avatars are shown and hidden, and which of them cost the most, scripts and geometry apart.
figuraperf.option.overlay_rows.tooltip: How many avatars the overlay lists.
figuraperf.option.overlay_offset.tooltip: Pixels to push the overlay down by, to clear a frame counter drawn by another mod.
figuraperf.hud.title: Figura Performance
figuraperf.hud.cost: that is %s%% of the frame, about %s fps
figuraperf.message.autoblocked: Avatar of %s hidden, it was costing %s ms a frame
key.figuraperf.toggle: Turn the mod on or off
key.figuraperf.block: Block the avatar you look at
figuraperf.option.distance.tooltip: Past this distance an avatar is not shown and the player falls back to their skin.
figuraperf.option.max_avatars.tooltip: Only this many of the nearest avatars are shown, the rest are hidden.
figuraperf.option.names_hint: Names separated by commas, case does not matter. For example: %s
